contexts.text: To be let down into Hell is not to be transferred from place to place... AC 1268.
They can speak as if in another place... And as if in many places at the same time. AC 1380.
When the idea of a place occurs, (all things done there come forth).
Concerning... place and distance there. General article. AC 1376.
The changes of place were nothing but changes of state, my body remaining in the same place.
Distance of place has no effect there.
Change of place and distance is only an appearance, according to the state...
It matters not that many are together in one place on Earth...
The idea of place and distance with Spirits is not anything real, but appears as if it were. It is nothing but the states of their thought and affection which are thus varied...

Change of place is only an appearance, and a fallacy of sense. For there are two species of changes of place there; one... when it is said that all Spirits... constantly keep their own place in the Grand Man - which is an appearance. The other is, that Spirits appear in a place when they are not there; which is a fallacy. AC 1380:end.

That place, change of place, and distance, are an appearance (there), is evident from the fact that all Spirits... appear constantly in their own places, and never change their places, except when their state is changed; and, as it is changed, so are the places and distances with them varied. But as everyone has a general state, which reigns... after these changes, they return to their own situation.
Spirits, as to the organics which constitute their bodies, are not in the place where they are seen. (Explained.)
They appear in the World of Spirits as changes of place; but in Heaven, as changes of state.
That place, and change of place... are also a fallacy. Shown.
Those not yet in their permanent situation are carried to various places. Explained.
Whenever translation from place to place occurs in the Word, the Angels (think) of nothing but such a change of state...
Unto the place (). Explained.
Right and left refers to no fixed place. Explained.
Place has nothing to do with being in the Hells; but state.
To be carried by the Spirit into another place. Explained. AC 1884. HH 441. AE 36, Explained.
Preface. (The internal sense is to be searched out in other places.)
The place and state of temptation. Signified.
The places in Canaan were variously representative. AC 9340:2. AC 10559:4. WH 12.
Room () = state.
In Heaven there is no idea of place, thus none of distance, but instead of them ideas of state. Explained, Illustrated.
(Dark places in the Word are understood by a wise reader from other places.)
Standing in the holy place () = vastation as to all things of good and truth. The holy place = a state of love and faith.
Origin of the representatives of places. AC 4447:2.
Jehovah is in this place () = that the Divine is in this state.
No place, nor time, in what is interior.
Truth and good in the first or second place. Explained. AC 4243. AC 4245. AC 4247:2. AC 4248. AC 4249. AC 4250. AC 4256. AC 4269. AC 6217. AC 6267. AC 6269:2. AC 6271. AC 6287. AC 6294.
(Method of naming places formerly.)
(Places in the Spiritual World.)
Progressions from place to place (there) are changes and progressions of the state of life.
A Spirit who varied his place...
These changes (of state) appear exactly like progressions from place to place. Explained.
Faith, which is apparently in the first place. Signified.
Are in the lowest place in His Kingdom.
(Things associated with places in the memory.) (Explained.)
The place on which thou standest () = the state in which he still is.
To the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite () = the region occupied by evils from falsities.
As soon as any place is left by good Spirits, it is occupied by evil ones...
These emissaries appear in their own fixed places in the World of Spirits; and from the places themselves where they appear it may be Known from what Hell they are. Enumerated.
Results from many places in the sense of the letter...
Their place in the Grand Man is allotted according to the quality of their good.
The state of life presents every appearance of place and state.
The state of affection and thought make the idea of place and distance (there).
The places of the planets are constant in the idea of Spirits...
The places where evil Spirits are. Described.
Changes of state are signified by journeys from one place to another.
It is states of truth and good, (or) of falsity and evil, which are represented by... distances and places (there). References.
In a place for Thee to dwell () = ... a state of good from the Divine; because Heaven is meant.
All the places to which the Israelites came = the state and quality of the Thing treated of.
To come to a place = to the state to which they shall be led.
In the internal sense, place is not meant, but every man with whom are faith and charity; for place = state.
As non-essentials; thus in the lowest place.
Regard themselves... in the first place.
Those who appear in one place are in a like state of affection and thought...
To bring thee to the place which I have prepared () = introduction into Heaven according to the good of love and of faith.
Place (there) corresponds to the state of life; and therefore the place (there) appears according to the state of life; and, in itself, is the state. References.
A Spirit is brought from place to place no otherwise than by changes of the state of his interiors; which changes appear to him as if they were moving from one place to another. Example(s).
The Angels of each Heaven are not in one place together...
From the form of Heaven everyone knows his own place.
The Angels have no idea of place and space. Explained.
When anyone is progressing from one place to another (there)... he arrives more quickly when he longs to do so, and less quickly when he does not long...
Hence it is that by places and spaces, in the Word, are signified such things as are of state. Enumerated.
The World of Spirits is a place intermediate... HH 428. Explained.

When a Spirit is in such a state, he appears in many other places, and everywhere as if present in the body; but this is only an appearance; and therefore as soon as he is brought into his reigning love, he vanishes... and is with his own in the Society to which he is attached.
Therefore everyone is Known (there) from the quarter and place where he dwells... In like manner when they go from place to place. Explained.
A place (there) called the Assembly of the Intelligent...
The names of persons and places (in the Word) = something of the Lord; and thence something of Heaven and the Church from Him; or something opposite.
In our Word, many names of places are retained (from) the ancient Word.
Everyone is allotted a place (there) according to his idea of God as a Man. TCR 110:2. TCR 163. AE 957:4.
Spirits and Angels appear in the place where their thought is...
Thus everyone... is prepared for his place in Heaven. DP 68.
But (such a man) is prepared for his place in Hell. Explained.
This place is opposite to a certain place in Heaven.
From these things everyone is allotted his place in the Lord; thus in Heaven, according to the quality of the conjunction... with Him.
Everyone is initiated into his place by the Lord according to his life.
The place of everyone is foreseen, and at the same time provided. AR 262.
The Lord provides their places for the evil by permitting and withdrawing; and He provides their places for the good by leading.

No one can sit in another's chamber except in his own place; in any other he becomes imbecile and dumb. Everyone knows his own place when he enters the chamber. In like manner in the temples; and in meetings. CL 23. SE 5972. SE 6056:end.
To be moved out of their places () = to recede.
A place prepared by God () = the state of that Church then. Explained. AE 731.
Their place was found no more in Heaven () = that they were sundered from their conjunction with Heaven, and cast down. See AE 736.
They are (then) relegated to their places (in Hell), everyone according to his own evil and falsity.
Place = the state of a Thing.
Everyone after death comes into his own place.
The Divine Esse is not in place; but with those and in those ho are in place...

(The idea of Heaven as a mere place. Described.) CL 10:7. There are places (there) as (here)... But still place there is not place; but is an appearance of place according to the state of love and wisdom.
There are three places... where such things are explored. Described.
After death his journeyings are collected into one, and a place is assigned him accordingly...
Every man, from infancy to old age, is changing his places or situations in that World. Described.
Spirits change places according to the change in them...
That place or situation where Spirits appear is only an appearance. Explained.
Yet they were all in one place; (and) myriads can appear in the same place, when not one of them is there...
No Angel or Spirit was for a moment out of his place...
That a multitude of men who are... in one place on earth may be widely separated (there). Explained. SE 2651, Explained.
For they must be in some place.
They also change places...
Such changes of places are fallacies...
If they were really all there, one would be inside another; thus entirely in one place.
That Spirits are in place. Explained.
Besides [the fact that] a Spirit is in one place, everyone can be in another sphere; for conjunction by places effects nothing...
Spirits are not only seen in certain fixed places; but their bodies [are also seen] in a fixed position. Explained.
They then seemed not to be in their own place... They were no longer heard in their own place.
Concerning the idea of place. - I observed that whenever I heard anything, I conceived the idea of a place...

When I have been long in one place, I can command my ideas better there... For the Spirits want to have the idea of place joined... I noticed, further, that one place has an advantage over another on account of the vicinity of the Spirits who seem to themselves to haunt it; and also on account of the men who are near and in the house. SE 3608.
That the ideas of Spirits are attached to place, and to the things which are in the place. Explained.

The Spirits began to doubt whether it is a fallacy, or an appearance, that Spirits appear at the right, left, etc.; supposing that such is their genuine place. But... it is thought which conjoins. Example(s).

Places are allotted (there) according to the nature and disposition; and therefore when the thought is perverted... he appears to himself to be elsewhere, which is a fallacy; but when the place is constant to them, it is an appearance.

The Spirits do not know but that they are in the place of which one is thinking... They are then without the reflection of place... (But when they are) Subjects, they have the reflection which the man has; as that of place, persons, etc.
As changes of places come from changes of Societies; and phantasies and ideas cause them to be changed as to places...
Although evil Spirits appear in other places, as overhead, this is a mere phantasy, and they are really in Hell.

Unless the Societies were in Divine order... a Spirit could not possibly move himself from place to place... To be moved from place to place, which is translation and progression, is an appearance and a fallacy; but it is circumstanced according to the variations of the idea or phantasy; thus of the corresponding Societies which are inflowing... Hence appear the changes of place...
That every place (there) is a change of state. Explained. SE 4652:end.
When a Spirit comes into another place, he does not know where he was before...
Heaven is not a place, but a state of life. Explained.
The World of Spirits is not a fixed place... but is the state in which they are...
All such know how to expatiate as to the thoughts, (and) thus to appear in many places.
All the places (there) are appearances of Divine truth in ultimates.
a. Everyone (there), wherever he appears, is really in that place where is his reigning love...
Every Spirit at last comes into that place (where) he is as it were in his own centre. Explained.
The ideas of places also are presented simultaneously...
All by whom the Word was being written were brought to the places which had the [required] signification.
Their place is not known () = that no (truth and good) are left.
The place of the Lord's feet () = all things of Heaven and the Church; and, in a particular sense, the Church.
The idea of place limits and bounds the thoughts... Angelic thought is devoid of places, etc.
Ye shall see this place no more () = that not anything of the Church shall be with them any longer.

The reason place = state, is that spaces, places, and distances (there) are, in their origin, states of life. They appear exactly as in this world; but differ in this: that the quality of everyone is known from the place where he dwells... Thus is it in general as to the places of all according to the quarters; in particular as to their places in the Societies; and in the singular as to their places in the houses; nay, in the chambers. Hence it is evident that the place and the quality of the state make a one...
Through dry places seeking rest = a state of evil and falsity which are of his life.
The Lord is in place; but not by means of place...
